tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ kha byang nyi ma'i snying po bzhugs so/ /

kha byang nyi ma'i snying po zhes bya ba/ dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdod ma'i mgon po rgyal ba gang can mtsho/ /mkhyen brtse'i rang bzhin gting dpag mi nus shing*/ /phyi ma'i mu mthar 'gro ba'i bde 'byung gnas/ /gang yin de la thog mar phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi bka' gsang rgya che las/ /nges pa'i snying po mngon sum 'od gsal lam/ / gsang ba snying thig yi ge grangs mang don/ /yang zab yid bzhin nor bu gsal bar bya/ /gsang ba yang gsang yang zab rmad byung gang*/ /gcig dang bzhi dang gsum tshan bcu dang gcig /skal ldan rnams kyi ma rig mun pa sel/ /rnam par dbye na sde tshan 'di dag go /lo rgyus dang ni dbang chog rnam pa bzhi/ /rgya mtsho skor gsum don khrid skor gsum dang*/ /rgyab yig skor gsum sprin phung skor gsum dang*/ /nam mkha' skor gsum bdud rtsi skor gsum dang*/ /sgron me skor gsum 'khor lo skor gsum dang*/ /gegs sel skor gsum nor bu skor gsum dang*/ /me long skor gsum snyan brgyud skor gsum dang*/ /sgrub thabs snying gi dum bu skor gsum mo/ /de dag so so'i dgos pa bstan pa ni/ /legs par bshad kyis rab tu yid la zung*/ /lo rgyus rin chen phreng ba nyid kyis ni/ /nges pa'i bka' la ngo mtshar yid ches bstan/ /dbang chog skor bzhis skal ldan smin pa ste/ /spros bcas bum dbang rdo rje'i sku thob cing*/ /bskyed rdzogs zung 'brel don la dbang bar byed/ /spros med gsang dbang rdo rje'i gsung thob cing*/ /ye shes drod 'bebs yi ge 'khor lo'i dbang*/ /shin tu spros med shes rab ye shes kyis/ /rdo rje'i thugs thob bde chen don la sbyor/ /rab tu spros med tshig dbang rin po ches/ /ye shes don thob gdod ma'i zad sar phyin/ /de yi phyir na dang por dbang thob gces/ /rgya mtsho skor gsum dngos grub myur du 'grub/ /de la dam tshig rnam grol rgya mtsho yis/

/spang blang mtshams phyed rang rgyud dag par byed/ /tshogs mchod rim pa yid bzhin rgya mtsho yis/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing dngos grub rnam gnyis thob/ /bla ma'i rim pa dngos grub rgya mtsho yis/ /byin rlabs tshad med rtogs pa rgyud la 'char/ /de yi phyir na 'di dag shin tu gces/ /don khrid skor gsum smin rjes grol bar byed/ / sngon 'gro sems sbyong bdun gyi don khrid kyis/ /gong ma'i don la 'jug pa'i rkang stegs byed/ /dngos gzhi 'od gsal snying po'i don khrid kyis/ /bde gshegs snying po'i don la dngos su sbyor/ /khregs chod ye babs sor gzhag don khrid kyis/ /gshis kyi ngang der mthar 'dzin sgro 'dogs gcod/ /de yi phyir na 'di dag snying dang 'dra/ /rgyab yig skor gsum nyams len yid ches bskyed/ khregs chod rgyab yig nam mkha' dri med kyis/ /bya rtsol gnyis med re dogs bral bar byed/ /thod rgal rgyab yig nyi zla gza' skar gyis/ /'od gsal rang snang gong 'phel btsan sa zin/ /btags grol rgyab yig yid bzhin lhun grub kyis/ /mngon gsum gong 'phel bar dor grol ba'i grogs/ /sprin phung skor gsum sems sbyong rgyab yig ste/ /dbang po dman rnams gong mar drang ba'i thabs/ /de la bde stong bdud rtsi'i sprin phung gis/ /bde chen ngang du 'od gsal chen por sbyor/ /rlung gi sbyor ba ye shes sprin phung gis/ /gsal stong gnyis med 'od gsal ngang la sbyor/ /rnam par mi rtog nam mkha'i sprin phung gis/ /chos nyid 'od gsal blo 'das chen por sbyor/ /de yi phyir na 'di dag grogs su gces/ /sgron me skor gsum yang zab gsal bar byed/ /de la gzhir snang ye shes sgron me yis/ /thog ma'i gnas lugs mched lugs gsal ba ston//dpe don gsal byed 'od gsal sgron me yis/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i nyams len snying por ston/ /nyams len gnad kyi sgron me gsal ba yis/

/snying po ye shes gnad du bsnun thabs ston/ /yi ge 'di gsum shin tu gces pa ste/ /snying dang mig 'dra med pa'i thabs med pas/ /gcig la gcig 'brel zung du tshogs par bya/ /rin chen gser la g.yu yis phra bkod bzhin/ /snying po'i de nyid gsal mdzes 'bar bar byed/ /'khor lo skor gsum rtag tu 'od gsal sbyor/ /de la gnad gsum chos nyid 'khor lo yis/ /lta stangs gzigs stangs gnad kyi snying po ston/ /nyin mtshan gnyis med 'od gsal 'khor lo yis/ /dngos dang rmi lam bag chags 'brel rgyun gcod/ /yang zab gnad bsdus ye shes 'khor lo yis/ /nyin mtshan ting 'dzin go rim gsal bar byed/ /de yi phyir na yang zab yi ge gsum/ /nyams len dus na shin tu gces pas na/ / goms shing 'dris pa'i grogs su mkhas pas zungs/ /gegs sel skor gsum nyams len mthar phyin byed/ /lus kyi gegs sel bdud rtsi'i ljon shing gis/ /'byung bzhi'i nad sel rtsa khams snyoms par byed/ /sgo yi gegs sel sgron ma snang byed kyis/ /'od gsal 'char sgo mig gi bcos thabs bshad/ /sems kyi gegs sel ye shes dri med kyis/ /ting 'dzin skyon bsal rig pa'i ye shes ston/ /yi ge 'di dag grogs su gces par zungs/ /nor bu skor gsum mchog dang thun mong 'grub/ /bla ma'i thugs sgrub yid bzhin nor bu yis/ /lta sgom rtogs pa byin rlabs dngos grub ster/ /yi dam thugs sgrub y-id bzhin nor bu yis/ /'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob par byed/ /mkha' 'gro'i thugs sgrub yid bzhin nor bu yis/ / las bzhi'i phrin las don gnyis 'grub par byed/ /de yi phyir na dkon pa'i yi ge gsum/ /sgrub pa'i grogs su med du mi rung bas/ /nyin mtshan thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor rim pa la/ /skal ldan rnams kyis rtag tu bsgom par bya/ / des na gegs dang bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub myur du thob/

/me long skor gsum 'di phyi'i don gnyis 'grub/ /de la ngo sprod dran pa'i me long gis/ /tshe 'dir yid ches bar dor grol bar byed/ /'ch-i ltas gsal byed dran pa'i me long gis/ /rnal 'byor phung po 'dor ba'i dus tshigs 'dzin/ /'chi bslu yang zab dran pa'i me long gis/ /dal 'byor ring gnas tshe 'di'i snang ba ston/ /de phyir 'di dag shin du gces pa yin/ /snyan brgyud skor gsum bar do'i gdams pa ston/ /snyan brgyud chung ngu ye shes rang snang gis/ /da lta'i nyams len gtso bor gsal bar byed/ /snyan brgyud 'bring po 'od gsal rang snang gis/ /bar do'i ngo sprod gdams pa gsal bar byed/ /snyan brgyud chen mo nges don rang snang gis/ /de dag kun gyi rgyab chos gsal bar byed/ /de yi phyir na dkon pa'i yi ge gsum/ /thig le gsang ba'i gnad la shin tu gces/ /gong ma'i skor rnams dpe brgyud gdams pa ste/ /gtso bor tshe 'dir grol ba'i man ngag bstan/ /snyan brgyud 'di gsum don brgyud gdams pa ste/ /gtso bor bar dor grol ba'i gdams pa bstan/ /'di gnyis gcig gi grogs su gcig dgos la/ /grub mtha' gcig pas yang gsang bla med kyi/ /yi ge yod med gdams pa'i khyad yin gsungs/ /gang las zhe na sgron ma snang byed las/ /yi ge med pa'i snyan brgyud 'di nyid 'brel/ /zhes gsungs de phyir zab mo'i snyan brgyud gsum/ /snying thig dngos yin bar dor grol ba'i chos/ /gsang skor zhes btags brda tsam shes par mdzod/ /gzhan ni yang 'dir de bzhin snying po gsum/ /de bas gnad 'di rab tu shes par gces/ /de dag rnams kyi chos mdzod bsrung ba la/ /rgyal ba rig 'dzin rim pas bka' bsgom pa/ /dam can rgya mtsho dpag gis mi lang yang*/ /gtso bo'i bka' srung sgrub thabs skor gsum las/ /ma mo'i gsang sgrub snying gi dum bu yis/ /rang dang chos srung 'gal byed chom la 'bebs/

/gza' rgod gsang sgrub snying gi dum bu yis/ / pha rol dgra dpung thal ba rdul du brlag /dam can gsang sgrub snying gi dum bu yis/ /bka' nyan las byed cho 'phrul bsam mi khyab/ /de yi phyir na dkon pa'i sgrub yig gsum/ /zhal gdams dmar khrid nyams len bkod pas na/ /rtag tu mchod bstod bskang gso'i las la 'bad/ /rang dang 'khor 'dab 'byor pa rgyas byed cing*/ /bar chad kun sel dngos grub yid bzhin gter/ /nor bu'i rgyal las yon tan lhag pa yin/ /de ltar chos sde sum cu rtsa lnga yis/ /thig le mchog gsang rdzogs pa chen po'i skor/ /shin tu yang zab gnad kun tshang bar bstan/ /rgyud lung man ngag shin tu grangs mang yang*/ /don rnams bsdus na 'di las lhag pa med/ /deng sang dus na tshe thung 'byor pa chung*/ /skal pa dman pas gdams pa thob par dka'/ /yi ge grangs mang kha tshang mthong bar dkon/ /mthong yang rang la mi 'dzom de yi phyir/ /nyung bsdus don 'grub rin chen snying po'i chos/ /yang zab yid bzhin nor bu'i snying po 'di/ /bdag gi rjes 'jug skal ldan don ched du/ /klong chen rab 'byams bzang po'i rnal 'byor pas/ /gangs ri thod dkar mgul du bkod pa yin/ /dge ba de yis srid pa khams gsum po/ /thams cad phyam cig 'khor ba'i mtsho brgal nas/ /gdod ma'i sa la rang bzhin lhun grub ste/ /bde chen kun bzang chos kyi rgyal por shog /kha byang nyi ma'i snying po zhes bya ba theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul/ o rgyan rdzong gi gnas su bkod pa rdzogs so// // dpal sngags kyi bdag mo dang*/ gza' bdud rā hu la dang*/ dam can rdo rje legs par gsum la/ kha byang 'di'i chos sde sum cu rtsa lnga po rnams gtad pa yin pas/ yi ge 'dra min 'chos pa byung na chad pa phob la sod cig /skal med la ma gtad cig /skal ldan la gtod cig /sa ma ya/ dge'o/
/dge'o/ /dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (9) kha byang nyi ma'i snying po/ - PAGE 6 -- PAGE 7 -- PAGE 1 -
